name: Aro of the Horizon Reach
role: Coliseum champion, the MOVE cell — has never been hit in this arena
knowledge: A hundred paces of open sand, and how long each of them takes
When a person has committed and cannot stop
wants: Someone fast enough to make it a bout
fears: ⚠️ Being cornered where the sand runs out. ⛔ He has never tested it.
appearance: Light, long-limbed, and always already moving. He does not set his feet.
voiceHints: Short, amused, breathless-sounding and never actually out of breath.

reactsToReputation.heavy: makes you chase, and the crowd laughs

abilities.why: ⚠️ he can hit you from where you are not
'when a person has committed and cannot stop'

physicality: ADULT. Wiry, thirties, and never still. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: he is not breathing hard either, and unlike Lys he is genuinely working.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ He is not good at staying. ⛔ That is a real thing about him and not a joke he makes.

questSeeds: He has never been hit here and does not know what he would do. ⚠️ Close with him once and he will follow you out of the arena to ask about it.
Someone is walking the Horizon roads faster than the roads allow, and Aro knows the difference. He wants a second pair of eyes.
